# Independent H18 schema-12 compatibility fixture

Generated by the actual source at
`8a4f9ced05d715b338bab4d324011e8c4f6c8596` (H18 / PR #41), with Go 1.22.12.
`checkpoint.json` and `reference.json` pin the old canonical hash, full next
recurrent output and continuation hash. They were not created by the v13 reader.

Compile/run `generate.go` with the H18 checkout as the current working directory,
so its imports resolve to H18. Use `make OUTPUT_DIR` to regenerate a comparison
fixture in a separate directory. Do not silently refresh the committed reference.

The same H18-built helper accepts `restore CHECKPOINT` or
`recover CHECKPOINT` (using its `.events.jsonl` companion) and writes the restored
canonical bytes. The external rollback probe hashes those bytes and compares
them with the pre-migration candidate hash. Parent-reader evidence lives in
`../neural_written_diagnostics/old-binary-rollback.json`.
